en.detail: This map was made with an older version of the path model, so its result is not read as a current finding. That is not the same as having no paths.

possible_paths.note: Peta jalur ini berdasar keadaan yang sudah terukur; seberapa besar Anda boleh melangkah tetap diatur Decision Spectrum (GO. STOP. OR DO SOMETHING ELSE). NOT YET berarti syaratnya belum terpenuhi dan bisa dibuka; STOP berarti jalur ini bertentangan dengan kondisi bisnis Anda sekarang atau sudah Anda hentikan.

note_i18n.en: This map of paths is built from what is measured today; how big a step you may take is still governed by the Decision Spectrum (GO. STOP. OR DO SOMETHING ELSE). NOT YET means the condition is not met yet and can be opened; STOP means this path collides with your business as it stands today, or you stopped it yourself.
